calls.statement:
SELECT 
  cp.category,
  ROUND(AVG(fsw.closing_value), 2) AS avg_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = fsw.week_ending_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fsw.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current = true
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fsw.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current = true
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND dd.fiscal_week BETWEEN 44 AND 47
  AND cs.region = 'West'
GROUP BY cp.category
ORDER BY cp.category
